name: @proworks-hub/spendiq
description: SpendIQ — spend analysis whose integrity core is the savings claim: an amount constructible only by derivation from a by-value baseline with a required basis, an assertion statement generated from the claim's own fields (stating what it does NOT assert), cost-avoidance structurally unreconcilable, three-bucket coverage where model proposals never inflate attribution, a required tail definition spanning published answers of 5% to 40%, and maverick spend that refuses rather than reporting zero on an unbound contract register.
author: Steven Kreutzer
